verdict.rationale: The first-party manual explicitly states that Working Copy supports the https, ssh, git and http protocols. The site also documents cloning repositories for full offline availability, and SSH key identities can be imported, generated, or held on the Secure Enclave. A community user reports using it against a self-hosted git server. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that names each protocol (HTTPS, SSH, git://) specifically for cloning.
